title: Core Rules
summary: The compact 2d6 resolution layer for Quadrath.

resolution.success: Meet or exceed the difficulty or target AC.
resolution.contested: Both sides roll 2d6 plus the most fitting bonus; ties favor the defender.
resolution.critical: A natural 12 on 2d6 always hits and rolls twice the listed damage dice.
resolution.fumble: A natural 2 always misses; there is no mandatory extra penalty.

tiers.description: Skilled practitioners beginning to make a name for themselves.
Renowned heroes capable of remarkable feats.
Living legends whose deeds shape Quadrath.

combat.initiative: Roll 2d6 plus the most fitting bonus; highest acts first.
combat.turn: Move up to Speed, take one action, and take at most one reaction before the next turn.
combat.attack: Roll 2d6 plus attack bonus. Meet or exceed AC to hit.
combat.damage: Roll the action's listed damage dice and subtract the result from HP.
combat.disengage: Use an action to move without provoking opportunity attacks.
combat.dodge: Use an action to give attackers -2 on attack rolls until your next turn.
combat.hp: At 0 HP, a creature is dead. At 10% HP, it is incapacitated with no direct recovery during combat unless a spell or potion says otherwise.

saving_throws.constitution: Poison, fire exposure, explosions, and physical endurance.
saving_throws.intelligence: Illusions, magical puzzles, mental effects, or spotting traps.

rest.short: About one hour in safety; restore 1d6 HP and recharge short-rest abilities.
rest.long: Restore all HP and daily abilities.

sections.heading: Character Levels
sections.text:
- 1 to 5: Novice  
    Starting adventurers finding their footing in the world, learning the basics of their craft.
    
- 5 to 10: Adept  
    Skilled practitioners who have honed their abilities and begun to make a name for themselves.
    
- 10 to 15: Master  
    Renowned heroes whose prowess is widely recognized, capable of feats that inspire awe.
    
- 15 to 20: Legendary  
    Living legends whose deeds shape the fate of Quadrath, wielding power that rivals the gods.

sections.heading: Quadrath
sections.text:
The *land of four sides*: North Kingdom, South Kingdom, West Kingdom and East Kingdom.

Quadrath is based on DnD 5e characters mostly and have all DnD classes and most races but ***fully geared towards Live Action RPG (LARPG) style of play***.
